thread:
samir: Heads up — reproducible crash in samplekit when jsonMode + function calling + token refresh all happen together. Posting quick repro and logs.
aj: can you paste the log snippet?
samir: sure. after auth refresh the LLM response payload we get back is double-encoded for function args. from network capture:
```
{"type":"function_call","name":"create_order","arguments":"{\"items\":[{\"id\":\"sku-1\",\"qty\":1}],\"user\":\"u-x\"}"}
```
samir: arguments should be an object, not a string. happens only when refresh token flow triggers retry.
maria: observed on JS samplekit. PY SDK seems to avoid it because it sends raw bytes instead of JS object in transport. parity concern.
jen: which part does the retry middleware live in? is it in sdk-core or in the example app?
aj: it's in sdk-core http client. hypothesis: retry middleware calls JSON.stringify for logging/metrics, then the transport also stringifies -> double stringify.
kevin: can reproduce locally by forcing a 401 and letting the automatic refresh run. thanks for the trace.
samir: local hack that helped: set request._alreadySerialized = true in samplekit -> stops second stringify. Ugly but confirms cause.
aj: plan: add a guard in transport to detect and skip re-serializing if body is a string or has _alreadySerialized flag. I'll open a small PR with an integration test that simulates auth refresh and inspects the wire payload.
maria: also add a contract note in SDK docs: transport expects body to be string/bytes; retry middleware must not mutate original.
jen: tiny UX suggestion: on jsonMode + fncall, if we detect arguments is a string, surface a clearer error pointing to retried request path instead of generic parse failure.
kevin: agree, docs + a helpful error will save a lot of onboarding time.
dev-bot: CI run triggered for pr #4279: auth-refresh-serialize-guard — 1 test failed: js-integration/auth-refresh-args-check
aj: i'll debug that failing test. probably missed one code path that serializes headers for metrics.
samir: adding a short troubleshooting blurb in samplekit README so customers hit by this during trials can self-fix:
```
// Troubleshooting: If you see "arguments" serialized as a JSON string in logs
// - Cause: retry/auth-refresh path double-serialized the request body
// - Workarounds: pin token refresh to main thread or update to SDK patch v0.8.1+ when released
// - Dev hint: look for transport middleware that runs JSON.stringify on an already-string body
```
maria: filing a follow-up to audit python SDK parity. assign to platform-infra team to verify transport contract.
kevin: action items: aj -> PR & tests, platform-infra -> audit py/js parity, devex -> add README blurb and enhanced error. keep this open until PR lands.
samir: thanks all, ping me if you need a repro workspace.
